subject: RELEASE statement
notes: kb/Work PB348 LANDED. RULE (`--check 14.9.32.3 "If identifier-1 is a function-identifier, it shall reference an alphanumeric or national function."` => OK). WHAT WAS ABSENT: nothing screened the function's result class in this position. The FROM phrase of RELEASE, WRITE and REWRITE alike bound its operand through SequentialIoBinder.WriteSource, an unconditional three-way hand-off that INSPECTED NOTHING, so each verb's own phrase rule was applied by no one. WHAT IS THERE NOW: MoveBinder.BindFromPhrase applies the rule from a FromPhraseRules row, ONE PER VERB, because the three verbs name DIFFERENT SETS and a scalar column would reject legal source: RELEASE (14.9.32.3 SR2) and WRITE (14.9.51.3 SR4) admit an alphanumeric or national function, REWRITE (14.9.35.3 SR9, the FILE phrase not specified) also admits a boolean one. The FILE-phrase readings (14.9.51.3 SR10, 14.9.35.3 SR8) are unreachable: the FILE arm is Annex A.4.13 item 2 and is declined COBOL1706 earlier. The class is read off the BOUND operand through the SAME Table-16 sender position the category screen uses (MoveBinder.SenderPosition), which is what makes a folded FUNCTION LENGTH -- it reaches the binder as a plain numeric literal -- answer 'numeric' rather than 'unknown'. DIAGNOSTIC COBOL1914. MEASURED before: `RELEASE SRT-REC FROM FUNCTION LENGTH(WS-A).` compiled clean at 85, 2002 and 2023 and released R=[8       ].
